mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,project_id,artifact_id,resource_kind,resource_id,schema_ref,schema_document_sha256, dependency_access_set_id,dependency_manifest_sha256 FROM artifact_content_binding b WHERE artifact_id=#{id}

SELECT m.tenant_id,m.project_id,m.access_set_id,m.manifest_json,m.manifest_sha256,m.content_sha256,m.member_count, m.schema_version,m.schema_manifest_sha256 FROM dependency_access_manifest m JOIN dependency_access_set s ON s.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND s.project_key=m.project_key AND s.access_set_id=m.access_set_id AND s.manifest_sha256=m.manifest_sha256 AND s.content_sha256=m.content_sha256 WHERE m.access_set_id=#{id}
SELECT upstream_version_id,rights_revision FROM dependency_access_member m WHERE access_set_id=#{id} ORDER BY upstream_version_id
SELECT version_id,owner_project_id,entity_kind,content_sha256 FROM version_registry v WHERE version_id=#{id}
SELECT write_id FROM formal_evaluation_exact_input_intent i WHERE artifact_id=#{id} LIMIT 2
